notes: 'hint' is the desired pronunciation (typically katakana). When present,
the app speaks this instead of the raw English word; katakana hints
automatically switch the TTS engine to Japanese voice for accuracy.
'note' captures requests we can't yet render reliably (accent shifts,
multi-pronunciation sequences) — kept for future SSML / recorded-audio
support. 'optional' = true means 'できれば' (apply if possible).

_accent_shifts_not_yet_applied._comment: Stress-only corrections — TTS engines need SSML <prosody>/<emphasis> or IPA <phoneme> to convey these reliably. For v1 these stay at the default TTS pronunciation; recommend recorded-audio override later.

_multi_pronunciation_not_yet_applied._comment: Plays two pronunciations in sequence — needs a small extension to the TTS service (queue + delay).

_other_special_cases.1260: plow/plough → 発音1回 (TTS reads the slash; need to strip slash variants before speaking)
